# Next Level Procurement

> Smarter Buying, Delivering Value. A procurement and sourcing partner that buys, ships and delivers for businesses and individuals.

## Services
- Purchasing and sourcing: from anywhere in the world to anywhere, including importation from China.
- Training on how to import from China: the Made in China StarterKit ($20).
- Personal shopping: for clients abroad who want to buy from the UK and have it sent to their country.
- Consumables supply: basic consumables for businesses and individuals, such as bin bags, microfibre cloths, disposable gloves and disposable napkins.
